symptom: `alter page … set (attribute: Assoc/Attr) on <textbox>` (and text area, date picker, drop-down, check box, radio buttons) said "Altered page" and stored a null AttributeRef; the fully qualified `"Mod"."Assoc"/"Mod"."Entity"/"Attr"` was stored verbatim as one flat attribute (mx 11.16.0: CE1613); even a bare `Attr` was nulled. create page binds all three.
cause: applySetProperties sent a built-in input's Attribute value to the mutator as written; setWidgetAttributeRefMut stored it only when it had two dots, else null, and never wrote association steps. create page's resolveInputAttribute was never consulted, and check's dry run of the same path agreed with the broken exec.
fix: resolveInputSetAttribute resolves the value against the widget's enclosing entity with create page's resolveInputAttribute and hands the mutator a backend.AttributeBinding (path + steps, EntityRef via widgetobj.AttributeEntityRefBSON); an unresolvable path or the `Mod.Entity/Attr` shape is refused (MDL-ATTRPATH02), and the mutator refuses an unqualified value instead of nulling it. check dry-runs the same function and adds create page's MDL-ATTRPATH01 warning via judgeQualifiedPath.
insight: The Data grid 2 column SET had been given the resolver (resolveColumnAttribute, #1644) while the built-in inputs beside it kept the raw-string route — whenever one SET target gains a create-page resolver, grep applySetProperties for the other targets of the same property name. The silent null was the mutator's own 'not qualified → nil' branch: a setter that maps an unrecognised value to empty is a success report for a no-op.
test: mdl/executor/alter_set_input_attribute_path_2278_pedapp_test.go (control: create page with the same paths; plain-attribute control MyFirstModule.Ord2278.Number stored as written; check MDL-ATTRPATH01 with short-form control; unresolvable paths refused by both)
